channel.title: Fieldlight Institute Reading Feed
channel.description: Research, systems, methods, and public writing from Fieldlight Institute and Anni McHenry.

item.title: On…
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: A poem, a garden, a remembered book, and the words that stay. A literary collage by Anni McHenry.

item.title: At Two Heights
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: Six photographs, one date, and the changing place of a person in the picture. A photographic essay by Anni McHenry.

item.title: Governed Human–AI Archive Acquisition
item.description: A compensated, identity-blind, no-human-read method for acquiring longitudinal conversational and coding-harness archives without acquiring the person.

item.title: Small Stories for the Child in All of Us
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: Three brief stories about quiet knowing, wild belonging, mischievous freedom, and the ways a living world speaks before anyone explains it.

item.title: The Right Not To Be Processed
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: Why custody, computation, and consent must be separate states—and why negative permission must be represented as an affirmative, enforceable instruction.

item.title: Theory of Signal Becoming
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: A working theory of how felt or symbolic recognition becomes stable authored form through recursive interaction—and the substrate that preserves continuity, correction, and origin while it changes.

item.title: Found Language Atlas
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: A living fieldwork atlas of 29 photographed encounters with public language and the symbolic threads they form across city, memory, objects, and creative work.

item.title: Cardiac Field and Social Interaction
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: A registered five-claim evidence ladder separating established cardiac physiology from open and unsupported claims about magnetic fields and social interaction.

item.title: One Export Is Not an Archive
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: A Fieldlight Archive Method implementation note showing why multiple export states—and preservation surfaces beyond exports—must be reconciled before longitudinal analysis.

item.title: The Fieldlight Archive Method
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: A repeatable human–AI method for stewarding a living personal corpus, amended with the rule that no single preservation surface should be presumed complete.

item.title: alt: a record of return
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: An interactive record of recurrence, recognition, and 202 favorite songs carried across twelve years.

item.title: Diviner | First Pages
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: The first public pages of Diviner: relational signal, asymmetrical activation, and machines that answer the body.

item.title: Local Authority, External Capability
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: Why local AI does not mean anti-cloud—and how external capability can remain governed by human-owned authority.

item.title: Fieldlight Mesh: What Works, What Doesn't Yet, and What Comes Next
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: A candid implementation review of the local-first network beneath Fieldlight's intelligence infrastructure.

item.title: Participant Charter
item.description: Twenty baseline rights that govern all human-AI research.

item.title: Institutional Transition Documentation Methodology
item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: A method for documenting places while their identity, use, ownership, or public meaning is changing.

item.author: anni@fieldlight.com (Anni McHenry)
item.description: Neighborhood intelligence utilities and the civic infrastructure of an automated society.
